priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Use Stormkeeper on cooldown, but delay it if Ascendance will be available in less than 10 seconds.
Use Ancestral Swiftness and Ascendance on cooldown, ensuring Ascendance is not used while Stormkeeper is active.
Use Blood Fury, Berserking, and Trinkets, ideally synchronized with Ascendance.
Cast Voltaic Blaze to apply or refresh Flame Shock if you do not have the Master of the Elements buff.
Spend Maelstrom on Earthquake (for 3+ targets) or Elemental Blast (exactly 3 targets) if the target does not have Lightning Rod active and you have fewer than 2 Tempest stacks.
Use Lava Burst if Purging Flames is active and you have a Lava Surge proc.
Cast Tempest if you have the Master of the Elements buff active.
Cast Tempest if you have 2 stacks of the buff and Stormkeeper is not currently active.
Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning if you have significant Maelstrom deficit.
Cast Earthquake as your primary Maelstrom spender when near maximum Maelstrom.
Cast Elemental Blast to spend Maelstrom if Earthquake is not preferred.
Cast Tempest whenever it is available and higher priority conditions are met.
Use Chain Lightning as your primary filler for 3 or more targets.
If moving, use Spiritwalker's Grace, or cast Flame Shock and Frost Shock to stay active.
